scripts.dev: npm run bootstrap:local && wrangler types && astro dev
scripts.build: wrangler types && astro check && astro build && npm run gate:content
scripts.gate:content: npm run gate:schema && npm run gate:sinks && npm run gate:ds && npm run gate:photo-date && npm run gate:exif && npm run gate:origin && npm run gate:routes && npm run gate:public-js && npm run gate:fonts && npm run gate:placeholders && npm run gate:ladder
scripts.deploy: npm run gate:deps && npm run build && npm test && npm run gate:content && wrangler deploy
scripts.//audit:public: JSON has no comment syntax, so the reason lives in this sibling key. `audit:public` is NOT chained into `npm test` or `npm run build`, and that is a decision: it needs a ~130 MB Chromium binary that no gate can install for you, and a browser measurement is deterministic PER MACHINE, not per platform - libvips, font rasterisation and sub-pixel layout all diverge on darwin/arm64 against ubuntu/x64, so a cross-platform pixel assertion is a flake generator. Phase 8 owns whether any of it becomes a CI gate under QUAL-01 and QUAL-04. Run `npx playwright install chromium` once, then `npm run build && npm run audit:public`.
